## Active - R10DH infrastructure refusal closed; corrected rerun authorized, 2026-10-02

SDK1 remains **14/20**, full program **14/25**. The [independent closure](../sdk/recovery/r10dh_production_ghost_closure_v1.json) preserves the physical attempt from clean pushed source `a538031075da7b3c6d91c9dd2b1c874293f11ac8`. One phase-71 no-kick world opened. Its worker reported 1,755 solver steps, finalized a 369,546,277-byte report, exited with code zero and emitted no stderr. The independent original reader then refused `R10DH_REPORT_IDENTITY`; this is an infrastructure-invalid attempt, not a qualified behavior result. The kicked cell was never opened. The single-use development population is consumed and cannot be retried.

The exact mismatch is in five nested numeric fields of `r10dh_campaign`: seed, prefix phase and the three file byte lengths. Godot's declaration parser materializes them as floats, the identity hook copies them, and the full-precision serializer emits values such as `93671.0`. The Python reader requires exact JSON equality against declaration integers such as `93671`. All five mismatches have equal numerical values; their wire types differ. Qualification tested the native producer and Python header checker separately, so it missed this actual serialization boundary. The original refusal is retained without weakening or rerunning its evaluator.

The post-exposure zero-world diagnosis is retained at `<evidence-root>/r10dh-production-ghost-closure-04a146b9c2f34b8ebd7407dda5dbd883/identity-diagnosis.json`, SHA-256 `sha256:fafd03f43c305fdcb17f2ed9cdd0e1b9a9d9e91e14408c0bc05d5bd260302d7e`. It binds the original report, declaration, reader refusal and closure, lists all five exact differences and grants no physical result or acceptance authority.

The durable owner and leaf cleanup both completed, and the owner exited. No R10DH process remains running. Held-out phases 72, 73 and 74 remain unopened; no held-out execution authority was issued and M07 is unsatisfied. moves are **546 upward, 51 vertically unchanged and zero downward**. Median
summed joint-deficit reduction is **0.008320 rad**; minimum target margin is
**0.003763 rad**. This is gradual recovery toward the declared margin, not a
claim that every target already has 0.02-rad clearance.

The tradeoff is explicit: **492 proposals increase the old geometry cost** while
recovering joint headroom. Per-step feasibility does not prove that the body
will follow, that a sequence will converge, or that non-foot support will

failures**, at least one limb has zero counted foot impulse while the same distal
body retains positive non-foot contact load: rear-right in **32/34**, front-left
in **11/34** (overlapping cases). The relevant contact points lie just outside
the original foot-cap boundary: rear-right **0.0445-0.2025 mm**, median **0.1088
mm**; front-left **0.00824-0.02178 mm**, median **0.01374 mm**. R10AA shows non-foot
load during zero-foot cases in 24 of its 44 loaded-rise transitions. These are
descriptions of two consumed runs, not a matched comparative effect.

The endpoint reconstruction separates joint and torso motion. All 136 R10AB
limb transitions move the modeled endpoint downward with the torso held fixed;
130/136 move upward when the observed torso motion is included. These are rigid
kinematic model outputs, not native contact-position measurements or a force
prediction. The host source captures transform and contact samples within the
same callback; no obvious host-side snapshot mismatch is established. Engine
contact sampling timing and native distal orientation remain to be examined.

**Next:** inspect native distal orientation and contact-point sampling relative

land outside the counted region; do not relax the foot definition or widen the

## Current product and evidence boundary

SDK1 keeps `sporespore_balanced_wave_v1` as a portable policy lineage and
targets bounded support through genuine Godot/Jolt, Rapier/Parry, and MuJoCo
adapters. It does not require formal equality of native trajectories or
effects and does not claim arbitrary morphology. Each engine instead needs an
explicit supported envelope, capability declaration, OOD/refusal behavior,
and finite evidence for every advertised movement. The retained lineage
now contains the accepted R23D78 finite current-profile three-engine turning
closure, R173 prone-to-standing conjunction, R05E exact-finite Godot/Jolt
morphology population, and BW5C finite material population. QSDK-R13 composes
those bounded facts into M08's explicit Godot/Jolt SDK product envelope. Broader
morphology/material combinations, formal equivalence, and every
remaining release gate remain independent claims.

Formal cross-engine equivalence and arbitrary or continuous physical
morphology move to SDK2, where high-throughput development may inform—but may
not replace—fresh held-out native validation. The full scope decision is in
the [master SDK roadmap](ENGINE_NEUTRAL_LOCOMOTION_SDK_BOOTSTRAP.md), and the
repeatable non-authoritative commissioning lane is in the
[research program](LOCOMOTION_GROUND_UP_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md).

Cole's explicit goal injection resumed hashed scientific work. The executable
full-program score is `14/25`. The separate versioned bounded-SDK1 mapping is
`14/20`; it defers formal equivalence and later generalization/robustness gates
without changing any full-program disposition or historical evidence claim.

Current M07 work has closed R10E-L3 as a distinct complete held-out finite
negative. R10E-L2 first completed a valid two-world development pair: the
local no-push and pushed recovery windows passed, the pushed world measured a
`0.06159316375851631 m/s` native effect, and both worlds failed the unchanged
full walking conjunction only on anchor error. That finite negative qualified a
separate six-world held-out identity but did not predict its result.

The held-out invocation built two worlds. Its baseline was a valid finite
negative. The push world applied the exact native `0.25 N s` impulse once and
stored a `0.06441572308540344 m/s` next-tick velocity change. It was invalidated
when the v1 receipt checker compared that host-real `Vector3.length()` value to
a separately computed binary64 norm, `0.06441572548995939 m/s`, using an
undeclared `1e-9` allowance. An empty-pair PowerShell binding then prevented the
terminal report. The remaining four worlds never opened; the identity is
consumed, `behavior_passed` is unavailable, and no push-recovery conclusion
exists.

R10E-L3 preserved the old validator and every physical and behavioral term. A
new validator replayed the producer's exact host-real magnitude operation only
for the redundant magnitude self-link; axis and impulse links remained scalar.
After clean source, official qualification, separate v3 freeze and authority
commits, and the committed-graph check, its sole physical invocation completed
all six worlds and three pairs. Every native effect and local recovery window
passed. Every world still failed the unchanged walking conjunction only on an
anchor-limit crossing whose first logged sample preceded the push. R10E-L3 is
therefore valid and complete but behavior-negative. `QSDK-R10`, M07, external
push recovery, and both scores remain unchanged; only zero-world diagnosis and
a distinct successor may follow.

P5M.3-R1 results.

## BW0 — pure contract and implementation

### Frozen profile

For descriptor torso-length scale `L`:

```text
heading_gain = 1.0 / L
yaw_gain = 1.0
velocity_gain = 0.30 * sqrt(L)
contact_loaded_swing_knee_max_speed = 3.25 rad/s
anchor_guard_activation_fraction = 0.85
anchor_guard_max_speed = 2.25 rad/s
```

The profile contains no conditional selector and no Candidate 35 interaction
score. All outputs must remain finite and continuous for the complete bounded
descriptor interval.

### Required Rust surface

Add, without removing the legacy surface:

```text
BalancedWaveProfile
balanced_wave_profile
BalancedWaveController
BalancedWaveControllerMemory
BalancedWaveControllerStepOutput
```

The implementation may share private deterministic wave mechanics with
Candidate 35 only if:

- Candidate 35 golden vectors remain exact;
- Candidate 35 runtime/memory/receipt identities remain unchanged;
- balanced-wave receipts name only the new policy/runtime/memory;
- the balanced-wave guard does not multiply by interaction score; and
- neither public controller can mutate the other's memory.

### BW0 acceptance

Before a physics world:

1. exact reference profile vector;
2. exact lower and upper torso-length boundary vectors;
3. property sweep over at least `10,001` evenly spaced `L` values;
4. finite outputs and strictly positive speed limits throughout;
5. maximum adjacent finite-difference jump no larger than the analytic
   derivative bound plus `1e-12`;
6. no branch surface in the profile receipt;
7. exact ordered eight-command output on a valid reference state;
8. ordered eight-zero safe output on every missing required observation;
9. expired, run, unsupported gait, and yaw-rate commands fail closed without
   memory advance;
10. deterministic replay returns byte-identical canonical receipts;
11. Candidate 35 pure and runtime tests remain exact; and
12. the full Rust workspace remains green.

BW0 grants no physical claim.

The implementation and formal zero-world runner are:

## Post-BW2 audit interlock before future cross-engine C6

The four-item post-C6 critique was re-evaluated after BW2-C selection rather
than against the older audited snapshot. Its current disposition is:

| Audit concern | Capability now present | Gate that remains open |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Friction was frozen | BW2 executed `69` material worlds across authored friction `0.00`, `0.20`, `0.40`, `0.60`, `0.80`, `1.00`, and `1.80` for BW2-A/B/C. | BW2-C retained one eligible nonzero-friction treatment nonwalk at `mu=0.80`, seed `16003`. BW3 and BW4 therefore remain mandatory before any material-robustness or cross-engine C6 claim. |
| The portable SDK had no balance machinery or connection | The portable core now owns whole-system COM, support geometry, centroidal allocation, full/partial endpoint maps, and bounded influence. The selected balanced-wave treatment physically applied nonzero stability commands in every eligible Godot/Jolt development world. | Influence is not evidence of balance improvement or recovery. Rough-terrain, push, and observation-fault campaigns remain mandatory, and Rapier/MuJoCo must connect the same selected policy and stability authority rather than reimplement policy in an adapter. |
| The SDK had one adapter | Godot/Jolt, Rapier/Parry, and MuJoCo adapters now clear their declared C0-C5 slices. | Rapier and MuJoCo still report C6, controller-policy authority, material/actuator characterization, and physical locomotion acceptance as false. |
| Candidate 35 was failure-shaped at a finer scale than its evidence | Candidate 35 is sealed as a legacy oracle. Selected BW2-C has an empty branch-surface set and a separately frozen policy/digest. | BW2 is an opened development cohort, not generalization evidence. Fresh validation, cold material acceptance, morphology coverage, and counterexample programs remain mandatory. |

This interlock does not reopen or reinterpret the rejected Candidate 35 C6 or
C6R campaigns. It prevents a *new* cross-engine C6 from opening until all of
the following are true:

1. BW3 validation and BW4 cold material acceptance pass under the exact
   selected BW2-C identity;
2. the frozen Godot/Jolt rough-terrain, external-push, and
   sensor-noise/latency campaigns pass;
3. Rapier and MuJoCo retain per-host material and actuator characterization
   receipts and physically execute the same selected portable controller and
   stability path; and
4. shared exact semantic/safety gates and engine-specific behavioral
   envelopes are frozen before the first complete cross-engine run.

Passing these prerequisites would authorize opening cross-engine C6. It would
not by itself establish arbitrary quadrupeds, continuous-volume coverage,
multi-leg locomotion, running, bipeds, or a completed SDK.

### Isolated characterization protocol

Characterization precedes profile publication and opens no gait. It uses
fixture `SDK.BW3.godot_jolt_material_sled.v1` at Godot/Jolt `120 Hz, 20/7`:

- one frictionless `0.00` control under the frozen `2 N` force;
- three independent ramps at each positive authored value;
- `180` settle ticks, then `60` ticks per force stage with the final `30`
  observed;
- a `1 N` force lattice from `0` through `80 N`, followed by `90`, `100`, and
  `110 N`;
- a breakaway bracket no wider than `2 N`, between the last classified
  `HELD` stage and first classified `SLIDING` stage;
- no more than `2 N` replicate spread in first-slide or lower-breakaway force;
- the already-frozen `2 N`/`0.05` operational monotonic allowances; and
- a third consecutive classified-sliding stage at the same fixed force as
  the preceding stage, with complete contact observations, less than `5 deg`
  tilt, and no steady-velocity or kinetic-coefficient claim.

The characterization is exactly `10` worlds and `19` gates. The conservative
controller coefficient remains
`min(1.0,floor(100*minimum_lower_empirical_ratio)/100)`. Selective replicate
reruns and post-result gate edits are forbidden. The first complete retained
result for one clean pushed source identity is final for that identity,
whether it passes or rejects.

Before physics, the additive runner must pass its six-gate no-world preflight:

```powershell
.\sdk\run_balanced_wave_bw3_material_characterization.ps1 -PreflightOnly
```

The physical result may then open once from clean pushed source with an
unused durable `report.json` target. Only an integrity-accepted result may be
converted into the three immutable adapter profiles used by validation.

adapter, support, actuation, contact-cycle, forward-relocation, recovery,
height, tilt, yaw, anchor, and hinge gates, but ended with
`0.1356338263 m` absolute lateral displacement against the frozen
`0.10 m` bound. `bounded_lateral_drift` was its only false walking receipt.
This is a behavioral counterexample, not an infrastructure failure and not
evidence that the threshold should be widened.

BW2-C therefore remains the historical BW2 development selection but does not
pass BW3. This source may not be rerun, the failed cell may not be replaced or
averaged away, and BW4 may not open. Any controller change requires a new
branch-free policy identity, a prospectively frozen repeat of BW2, and—only if
selected there—a separately identified BW3 campaign.

## BW5 — fresh morphology and nuisance order

Only after BW4 passes:

1. freeze new low-discrepancy quadruped development/validation/cold indices;
2. preserve exact branch-boundary cells only as Candidate 35 oracle tests, not
   balanced-wave selectors;

7. characterize and repeat on Rapier;
8. characterize and repeat on MuJoCo; and
9. open cross-engine C6 only after every predecessor gate passes; and
10. add command-conditioned quadruped turning as the first new locomotion
    capability after the straight-walking multi-host slice, with signed
    left/right commands, zero-command compatibility, and curve-relative gates.

At this historical ordering boundary, turning was not implemented or evidenced.
The later public source contract under [`../sdk/turning`](../sdk/turning/README.md)
now qualifies the selected policy's bounded absolute-heading mechanism, and
QSDK-R23D1 later consumed its nine-process physical attempt but closed
implementation-invalid and incomplete with no three-engine scientific result.
Neither source boundary is physical turning evidence. The distinct QSDK-R23D2
successor must not reuse the straight-line lateral-drift corridor for
intentional curved motion. Continuous full-volume certification, variable
topology, running, bipeds, and production packaging remain later phases in the
engine-neutral SDK bootstrap.

## BW4R — continuous-feedback successor development

The rejected BW4 report exposed a held-feedback weakness without authorizing a
friction-specific patch. The parent portable runtime sampled cross-track
position, cross-track velocity, and yaw once every `90` semantic steps and held
the requested stride asymmetry between samples. BW4R freezes two additive,
branch-free alternatives before either opens a physics world:

| Candidate | Policy ID | Feedback cadence | Per-step steering-fraction slew |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| BW4R-A | `sporespore_balanced_wave_bw4r_a_v1` | every semantic step | direct application of the already bounded request |
| BW4R-B | `sporespore_balanced_wave_bw4r_b_v1` | every semantic step | `0.80 / 90`, permitting a full `-0.40` to `+0.40` reversal within the legacy hold interval |

Every gait, morphology, material, stability, mapping, and limiter field is
inherited byte-for-byte from BW2R-C. Neither candidate contains a friction,
material, morphology, seed, cohort, or outcome branch. The exact prospective
contract is
[`../sdk/balanced_wave_bw4r_preregistration.json`](../sdk/balanced_wave_bw4r_preregistration.json).
Its candidate digests are:

```text
BW4R-A sha256:40dc551e99fea518df68c35d49e3d7d9605484e25cb385f938b3568ddcab2cf4
BW4R-B sha256:2496dc6da6dea17cfc7ffee0027234fa7a2a0f4eea8bc463a68db9a9d105bae7
```

The old BW4 gate used world X/Z as forward/lateral proxies despite the frozen
nonzero fixture yaw. That historical result is not rewritten. Before the first
BW4R world, the successor freezes the correct task-frame projections:

```text
forward = dot(world displacement, frozen initial forward axis)
lateral = dot(world displacement, frozen initial lateral axis)
```

The lateral ceiling remains `0.10 m`; no threshold was relaxed and no failed
cell was removed. Every future receipt now records the axes and projected
forward/lateral displacements explicitly.

The same pre-world conformance pass also found that Rust's canonical JSON
preserved integral binary64 spellings such as `1.0`, while Godot's documented
canonicalizer normalizes them to `1`. Rust now implements the same exact-JSON
integer bound, negative-zero/integral normalization, and 14-significant-digit
binary64 quantization. Unit tests bind both number policy and the unchanged
BW2R-C profile digest, so engine-neutral receipt hashes cannot silently diverge
by host serializer.

Each candidate must complete all `58` opened-development worlds:

- `2` reference worlds;
- `23` opened BW2 material worlds;
- `4` opened morphology counterexamples;
- `12` opened BW3R validation worlds, now development-only; and
- `17` opened BW4 worlds, now development-only.

Early stopping is forbidden. The source-bound compiler
[`../sdk/compile_balanced_wave_bw4r_selection.ps1`](../sdk/compile_balanced_wave_bw4r_selection.ps1)
requires both five-report sets and all `116` worlds. It recomputes outcome and
walking-gate counts and applies the preregistered lexicographic order. A
candidate is selectable only if all opened-BW4 positive treatments walk. If
neither qualifies, the complete family is retained and rejected.

## BW5R — cycle-normalized filtered-feedback successor

The next identity is frozen in
[`../sdk/balanced_wave_bw5r_preregistration.json`](../sdk/balanced_wave_bw5r_preregistration.json)
before its first physics world. It implements the experiment shape recorded
prospectively in the
[research source ledger](research/LOCOMOTION_RESEARCH_SOURCES.md) from
DReCon pages 5–7:

```text
filtered[n] =
  filtered[n-1] + alpha * (bounded_raw[n] - filtered[n-1])

alpha =
  1 - exp(-1 / (time_constant_cycle_fraction * 360))
```

The local research source is
`<repo>\DReCon.pdf`, SHA-256
`aee8a67b3532ca3cd3cc80b51248b2db94dfb175fcae0d653f90c9b3c70c2a54`,
DOI `10.1145/3355089.3356536`. BW5R adopts its deterministic-reference plus
recursively filtered bounded-correction pattern. It does not copy DReCon's
network, query rate, numeric `beta`, humanoid data, or outcome claims.

All three candidates inherit every BW2R-C gait, morphology, material,
stability, actuator, mapping, and limiter field. All recompute bounded feedback
on every semantic step. Their only difference is one globally defined filter
time constant:

| Candidate | Policy ID | Time constant |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| BW5R-A | `sporespore_balanced_wave_bw5r_a_v1` | `1/32` gait cycle |
| BW5R-B | `sporespore_balanced_wave_bw5r_b_v1` | `1/16` gait cycle |
| BW5R-C | `sporespore_balanced_wave_bw5r_c_v1` | `1/8` gait cycle |

The candidate policy digests are:


The controller-step receipt is upgraded to

## Frozen BW9L scheduler-aware load-transfer successor

BW8U showed that changing a held joint target at the loaded release gate was
not the missing mechanism. Knee-only B changed none of control A's ranked
physics because the inherited position controller was already at its
`3.5 rad/s` velocity cap. Moving the loaded hip toward midswing in C and D
damaged walking. BW9L therefore leaves the complete BW5R-B gait policy,
release predicate, timeout, material, morphology contract, and walking gates
unchanged and moves the next hypothesis into the portable stability layer.

[`../sdk/balanced_wave_bw9l_preregistration.json`](../sdk/balanced_wave_bw9l_preregistration.json)
freezes a complete `2 x 2` before any BW9L physics world:

- A: all-support centroid and no preferred normal-force redistribution;
- B: zero preferred normal force at the scheduled still-bearing swing contact
  and equal weight preference at the remaining contacts;
- C: remaining-support-centroid lateral target with no normal-force
  redistribution; and
- D: both portable mechanisms.

The activation predicate uses only the morphology-declared phase scheduler,
nonzero gait amplitude, the ordered qualified-contact set, and the requirement
that exactly one scheduled swing contact is still bearing while at least three
support contacts remain. It adds zero tuned numeric constants and exposes zero
morphology, friction, material, seed, cohort, or outcome branch surfaces. The
centroidal gains are the already-retained P5I3C values moved into the portable
Rust core unchanged.

The portable operation `ss_plan_scheduled_load_transfer_v1_json` is exposed
through the checked-in C header, Python binding, Godot GDExtension, and
Godot/Jolt authority adapter. The core emits the complete centroidal request,
command, ordered contact preferences, activation reason, and typed receipt.
Godot maps and bounds that command through the existing endpoint-force and
motor-authority path. Receipts explicitly state that per-foot measured load
allocation is unavailable; preferred normal force is a command objective, not
a claimed force measurement.

Frozen identities:

- canonical preregistration:
  `sha256:b0b708bc6bcfd5475606b4014295f204a9b9d64846eb60d362b355184a5e2767`;
- raw preregistration:
  `da66fd10e7596b69858631eda41cdba7661b638610dbd788c7bd3269452bf85b`;
- no-world authority contract:
  [`../tests/test_sdk_balanced_wave_bw9l_authority_contract.gd`](../tests/test_sdk_balanced_wave_bw9l_authority_contract.gd),
  passing `5/5`;
- physical development harness:
  [`../tests/test_sdk_balanced_wave_bw9l_development.gd`](../tests/test_sdk_balanced_wave_bw9l_development.gd);
- clean-source evidence runner:
  [`../sdk/run_balanced_wave_bw9l_development.ps1`](../sdk/run_balanced_wave_bw9l_development.ps1);
  and
- preregistered fail-closed selector:
  [`../sdk/compile_balanced_wave_bw9l_selection.ps1`](../sdk/compile_balanced_wave_bw9l_selection.ps1).

All four zero-world 12-cell preflights pass. The physical matrix is still

failure. The Godot/Jolt adapter calls this planner before its support-count
shortcut, so the later physical runner can require exactly one hashable plan
receipt per SDK step.

## BW11R v3 corrected-successor implementation boundary

BW11R is a new additive schema and policy family. It does not patch frozen v2
receipts or reopen BW10F.

Implementation paths:

- portable request, receipt, validation, and planner:
  [`../sdk/core/src/stability.rs`](../sdk/core/src/stability.rs);
- public JSON ABI:
  [`../sdk/core/src/ffi.rs`](../sdk/core/src/ffi.rs) and
  [`../sdk/include/sporespore_locomotion.h`](../sdk/include/sporespore_locomotion.h);
- Python and Godot native bindings:
  [`../sdk/python/sporespore_locomotion.py`](../sdk/python/sporespore_locomotion.py)
  and
  [`../sdk/adapters/godot/src/lib.rs`](../sdk/adapters/godot/src/lib.rs);
- Godot/Jolt per-step receipt injection and manifest v15 routing:
  [`../scripts/lab/gait/sdk_godot_jolt_adapter.gd`](../scripts/lab/gait/sdk_godot_jolt_adapter.gd);
- cross-language no-world authority contract:
  [`../tests/test_sdk_scheduled_load_transfer_v3_authority_contract.gd`](../tests/test_sdk_scheduled_load_transfer_v3_authority_contract.gd);
  and
- exact full-integrity-gate satisfiability:
  [`../tests/test_sdk_full_integrity_gate_satisfiability.gd`](../tests/test_sdk_full_integrity_gate_satisfiability.gd).

The unavailable-observation path is portable authority. It accepts no
contradictory availability/state/reason combination, retains the semantic
step and scheduler order, and emits a typed safe-zero receipt without asking
the host adapter to invent a plan. Godot records that receipt before mapping
or overlay validation, so receipt count can remain equal to SDK step count
even after complete support-observation loss.

The first full-gate preflight used for BW11R was a freeze blocker. It called the same
`_analyze_cell`, `_common_execution_integrity`, treatment-actuation, and
candidate-mechanism predicates used by physical cells. Each of A/B/C/D must
accept a synthetic perfect result under its declared policy, including one
typed unavailable step. The A control arm requires exact zero stability
activity; B/C/D require nonzero activity. This prospective test would have
rejected both BW9L and BW10F before their first world. It did not yet execute
the declared policy to produce those activity fields; BW12E later proved that
remaining gap.

### Implemented successor preflight boundary

The post-BW11R implementation is now in:

the same gait clock, perturbation, robustness, steering, actuator, motor,

evidence acquisition, fixture, controller-configuration, realized-solver, and
material-profile validation used by the physical call. It returns only after

the engine tick rate or insert a node.

The first combined test invoked that real entrypoint for all four v3 policy
identities, verifies the declared stability and base-controller identities,
then invokes the exact shared post-physics integrity analysis on the
constructed policy-shaped synthetic receipt. “Perfect zero” means every
error, mismatch, failure, and violation count is zero. It does not erase a
production mechanism predicate: the historical BW11R/BW12E declaration
required control A to retain exactly zero stability activity, while treatment
B/C/D retained a minimal bounded nonzero activity witness.

At that checkpoint the no-world result was `3/3`: all four entrypoint receipts and all four
full-gate receipts pass; actual world builds, SceneTree insertions, physics
state changes, exposed locomotion outcomes, and physical acceptance authority
are all zero. An intentionally malformed synthetic partition still fails
closed. A new successor runner must execute and validate this single combined
receipt in a separate process before it creates a physical campaign process
or durable campaign-output directory.

BW12E-A exposed a control-semantics mismatch. Its scheduled load-transfer
receipt correctly remained inactive for all `18,168` steps: aggregate active,
preferred-normal, and remaining-centroid factor counts were all zero. However,
the v3 control policy preserves the baseline centroidal command on available
observations. The Godot adapter applies that contribution without requiring
the scheduled-load-transfer `active` flag. Consequently every A world had
physical stability influence, totaling `112,374` nonzero effective motor
applications. The preregistration had incorrectly equated “both experimental
factors disabled” with “the entire stability overlay is exact zero.”

The first combined preflight caught the BW11R entrypoint allowlist defect, but
BW12E proves its remaining boundary was too weak: it constructed a
policy-shaped perfect receipt and passed that receipt through the production
integrity analyzer; it did not make the real declared policy produce the
receipt. Thus it proved gate satisfiability but not policy-semantic
satisfiability. A successor must run each declared policy over deterministic
synthetic available and unavailable observations, derive the synthetic
full-result fields from those real portable receipts, and then pass the exact
production gate and candidate-specific control/treatment mechanism contract
before a world or durable campaign directory can open.

The post-result compiler has no selection path:
[`../sdk/compile_balanced_wave_bw12e_negative_closure.ps1`](../sdk/compile_balanced_wave_bw12e_negative_closure.ps1).
It pins all four report bytes, every per-report transcript, the family and
selector logs, the frozen sources, all aggregate counts, the precise
control-semantics failure, false downstream claims, and the unopened
independent/friction reservations. BW12E may not be repaired, relabeled,
ranked post hoc, or rerun; a new identity is required.

## Mandatory policy-semantic full-gate preflight v2

BW12E changes the successor launch contract. A hand-constructed “perfect”
receipt is no longer sufficient, even when it passes the exact production
integrity analyzer. Before any successor world or durable campaign output can
open, every declared policy must produce its own no-world semantic witness.

The implementation is split across:

- the real portable v3 planner, endpoint-force mapper, and bounded-influence
  adapter paths in
  [`../scripts/lab/gait/sdk_godot_jolt_adapter.gd`](../scripts/lab/gait/sdk_godot_jolt_adapter.gd);
- the exact shared production analyzer and synthetic-result compiler in
  [`../tests/test_sdk_godot_jolt_material_robustness.gd`](../tests/test_sdk_godot_jolt_material_robustness.gd);
  and
- the all-policy, zero-world launch gate and BW12E regression in
  [`../tests/test_sdk_full_integrity_gate_satisfiability.gd`](../tests/test_sdk_full_integrity_gate_satisfiability.gd).

For each A/B/C/D policy, the v2 preflight now:

1. traverses the real physical entrypoint through the final pre-fixture return;
2. starts the real Godot adapter without constructing or inserting a world;
3. compiles the real portable morphology;
4. runs the declared portable policy on a deterministic available,
   deliberately off-center support observation;
5. sends the resulting centroidal command through the real endpoint-force
   mapping and bounded-contribution limiter;
6. runs a deterministic observation-unavailable sample through the portable
   typed fail-zero path; and
7. derives the mechanism-activity fields of a synthetic full result from
   those receipts before calling the exact production `_analyze_cell` and
   integrity predicates.

“Perfect” continues to mean zero errors, mismatches, failures, and violations.
It does not mean erasing behavior the declared policy really produces. The v3
factorial control disables both experimental scheduled-load-transfer factors,
but preserves the shared baseline centroidal correction. Therefore all four
arms require a nonzero baseline feedback/mapping/application witness, while
factor activity is checked separately: A must be inactive and B/C/D active in
their declared modes. Every arm must also produce eight ordered safe-zero
contributions for the unavailable observation.

The exact BW12E regression replays the real A-policy witness against BW12E’s
old whole-overlay exact-zero declaration. It must return
`DECLARED_POLICY_MECHANISM_UNSATISFIABLE`. This is the failure BW12E should
have produced before its first world. A caller that omits the real semantic
witness now returns `POLICY_SEMANTIC_WITNESS_REQUIRED`; this seals the
historical BW11R/BW12E candidate harnesses against an accidental later launch.

The current no-world contract passes `6/6`. Its aggregate receipt is
`sporespore_full_integrity_gate_satisfiability_receipt_v2` and records:

- all four real entrypoint receipts;
- all four real policy-semantic witnesses;
- the four exact production full-gate receipts;
- `bw12e_exact_zero_control_mismatch_detected=true`;
- `missing_policy_semantic_witness_rejected=true`;
- zero world builds, zero SceneTree insertions, and no physics-state change;
  and
- no locomotion outcome or physical-acceptance authority.

The clean pushed-source checkpoint is retained outside the temp filesystem at
`<evidence-root>\successor-policy-semantic-preflight-72927b7`.
Transcript hashes, source hashes, engine identity, exact no-world counts, and
the three research PDFs are indexed by
[`../sdk/policy_semantic_preflight_checkpoint_manifest.json`](../sdk/policy_semantic_preflight_checkpoint_manifest.json).

This preflight proves launch-contract satisfiability only. It does not repair
or reopen BW12E, select an arm, establish walking or balance performance, or

## Development-only BW13P successor checkpoint

After the rejected `33/36` QSDK-R05B result, the additive portable successor
under development is `BW13P`. It is a branch-free four-arm progressive
load-transfer family: A retains equal commanded-weight preferences as the
control, B progressively redistributes the scheduled contact's normal-force
preference, C progressively shifts the lateral target toward the
remaining-support centroid, and D combines both factors. Progress is the
smoothstep of normalized scheduler-declared local swing phase. Total preferred
normal force is conserved exactly. No R05B morphology, seed, failure identity,
material, or observed outcome appears in a branch condition.

The executable definitions are in
[`../sdk/core/src/stability.rs`](../sdk/core/src/stability.rs), with public
exports in [`../sdk/core/src/lib.rs`](../sdk/core/src/lib.rs), public C-ABI
coverage in [`../sdk/core/src/ffi.rs`](../sdk/core/src/ffi.rs), and Godot/Jolt
routing in
[`../scripts/lab/gait/sdk_godot_jolt_adapter.gd`](../scripts/lab/gait/sdk_godot_jolt_adapter.gd).
The planner uses the predecessor only for raw scheduler/support geometry; it
does not inherit the predecessor command's feasibility verdict. A unit
counterexample keeps that distinction executable.

The mandatory pre-world boundary now applies to both four-arm v3 families.
[`../tests/test_sdk_scheduled_load_transfer_v3_authority_contract.gd`](../tests/test_sdk_scheduled_load_transfer_v3_authority_contract.gd)
requires available and typed-unavailable public receipts for all eight
policies. [`../tests/test_sdk_full_integrity_gate_satisfiability.gd`](../tests/test_sdk_full_integrity_gate_satisfiability.gd)
then runs every declaration through the real physical entrypoint, portable
planner, endpoint-force map, bounded influence, and exact production analyzer
against a declared-policy-derived perfect synthetic result. This is the
general successor preflight requested after BW9L/BW10F: if a perfect
all-zero-error campaign cannot satisfy the entire gate, the experiment is
unrunnable and must stop before a world or durable output path exists.

This checkpoint has no physical or selection authority. The required
development freeze is now
[`../sdk/balanced_wave_bw13p_morphology_development_preregistration.json`](../sdk/balanced_wave_bw13p_morphology_development_preregistration.json),
raw SHA-256
`3d3433f6e9fa05790bb493eb3190fd174a543311bf143972b7ae0ed18b3207b7`.
It binds A/B/C/D to the same outcome-exposed R05B `12 x 3` matrix for paired
hypothesis selection and reserves fresh R05C indices `193`-`204` and seeds
`38101`-`38103` for later outcome-unexposed validation. Development walking
outcomes are recorded rather than converted into harness failures; execution,
mechanism, finite selection metrics, and combined-application integrity remain
mandatory in all `144` cells.

The runner
[`../sdk/run_balanced_wave_bw13p_morphology_development.ps1`](../sdk/run_balanced_wave_bw13p_morphology_development.ps1),
Godot harness
[`../tests/test_sdk_balanced_wave_bw13p_morphology_development.gd`](../tests/test_sdk_balanced_wave_bw13p_morphology_development.gd),
and selector
[`../sdk/compile_balanced_wave_bw13p_selection.ps1`](../sdk/compile_balanced_wave_bw13p_selection.ps1)
implement the frozen boundary. The runner work found and closed a real
pre-world integration defect: under `post_settle_full`, the adapter computed
the new stability contribution but the physical gait called base-only
authority. BW13P full authority now performs one combined portable-base-plus-
bounded-contribution write per motor while retaining zero legacy post-settle/
evidence writes and zero direct body writes. Historical R05 and overlay modes
retain their existing paths.

The complete candidate-specific preflight requires the public v3 contract,
the exact all-policy production gate, a real combined eight-motor application
witness using the declared BW13P policy, exact generated cells, all `36`
zero-world adapter starts, retained-source resolution/hashing, and a perfect
synthetic `36`-cell final aggregate report serialization/hash/readback. A
candidate whose final integrity predicate cannot accept that perfect result is
unrunnable. All A/B/C/D invocations pass with zero worlds:

```powershell
foreach ($candidate in "BW13P-A", "BW13P-B", "BW13P-C", "BW13P-D") {
    .\sdk\run_balanced_wave_bw13p_morphology_development.ps1 `
        -Candidate $candidate `

```

Physical execution remains disallowed until this freeze is committed and
pushed so `HEAD` exactly matches `origin/main`. Each first complete candidate

integrity-green reports and may select only B/C/D, only when the treatment is

morphology, arbitrary-quadruped, balance-improvement, material, cross-engine,
running, completed-SDK, or release evidence.

## BW13P-aa92940 closure and receipt-v4 successor preflight

The first physical BW13P source is a retained invalid negative, not a
near-pass. Commit `aa92940e6f8aca258df17d051dc7fd8c294d4eb7` completed all
`36/36` BW13P-A worlds, but the final report accepted `0/36` integrity gates.
Its retained report is
`<evidence-root>\bw13p-morphology-development-aa92940\BW13P-A\report.json`,
SHA-256
`7be88cafdafd1d3e07149621e5b845feb156154c6dcc1805e342b51285153766`.
The exact closure is
[`../sdk/balanced_wave_bw13p_aa92940_closure_manifest.json`](../sdk/balanced_wave_bw13p_aa92940_closure_manifest.json).
It forbids repair or rerun of A, launch of B/C/D from that source, selection,
or reclassification.

The common defect was at a real later runtime boundary that the earlier
startup and aggregate preflights never executed. Each declared negative
phase offset was applied directly to gait memory, producing a negative
`gait_step` that could not cross the native Rust `u64` schema. The worlds'
visible fallback movement was legacy-only behavior and is not SDK evidence.

The corrected adapter keeps `gait_step` as a nonnegative monotonic clock and
represents signed cyclic phase with a common whole-cycle epoch shift. If any
limb would underflow, every limb receives the same `360`-tick shift. Relative
phase and contact-gate skew are therefore unchanged. The v2 phase receipt in
[`../scripts/lab/gait/sdk_godot_jolt_adapter.gd`](../scripts/lab/gait/sdk_godot_jolt_adapter.gd)
records the original signed offset and the common representation shift, and
native/legacy parity compares the represented clock explicitly.

Every successor launch now has two nested zero-world proofs:

1. `preflight_perfect_declared_policy_runtime_boundary()` applies the actual
   declared phase transition, verifies nonnegative current memory, calls the
   real native balanced-wave controller, verifies eight semantic-order motor
   commands and nonnegative next memory, and invokes the real portable
   scheduled-load-transfer planner.
2. [`../tests/test_sdk_full_integrity_gate_satisfiability.gd`](../tests/test_sdk_full_integrity_gate_satisfiability.gd)
   runs that runtime witness for all four BW13P policies at both declared
   offsets (`-3`, `-2`), then executes the real entrypoint, policy semantics,
   endpoint-force mapping, bounded contribution, combined application,
   unavailable-observation safe-zero path, and exact production analyzer on a
   declared-policy-derived perfect zero-error/mismatch/failure/violation
   result.

The aggregate schema is
`sporespore_full_integrity_gate_satisfiability_receipt_v4`. It passes `8/8`
unique policy/offset runtime boundaries with zero fixture builds, zero
SceneTree insertions, no physics-state mutation, and no locomotion or physical
authority. The generic R05 preflight additionally runs the same boundary on
each of its `36/36` exact campaign entrypoints. The R05, R05A, and BW13P
launchers reconcile the v4 schema and individual witness details before a
durable evidence directory or physical process may exist.

The complete [`../sdk/run_conformance.ps1`](../sdk/run_conformance.ps1) suite
passed on 2026-07-29, including portable core `87/87`, Godot adapter `2/2`,
Rapier `5/5`, physical phase-offset commissioning `9/9`, all eight successor
runtime witnesses, all `36/36` R05 entrypoint witnesses, adapter authoring,
versioning, and developer-experience source conformance. This establishes
that the successor launch contract is executable on a perfect declared input.
It does not provide a physical outcome, repair the rejected source, select a
policy, or authorize a new world. The next legal physical action is a new
prospectively frozen successor identity built on the corrected boundary.

## BW13P-R1 invalid family closure and receipt-v5 successor boundary

This section supersedes the unopened status above. Source
`06a4ea6efecb91abbcbf73457375b51a1512f59b` completed all four R1 arms and
retained `144/144` parseable receipts under
`<evidence-root>\bw13p-r1-morphology-development-06a4ea6-complete-attempt-2`.
All four reports are physically complete as an attempted family but
integrity-invalid as candidate reports:

| Candidate | Report SHA-256 | Integrity | Mechanism | Combined application | Walking |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| BW13P-A | `a007250d6a1ddd874efcf5943ff4a26ded351cf29ec07660cfa328a51453c88e` | 0/36 | 36/36 | 0/36 | 0/36 |
| BW13P-B | `de499796983d3ed1e9e58eb8cd1d5dc6078c4ebc2db3e8befa9aa26dc804012a` | 0/36 | 36/36 | 0/36 | 0/36 |
| BW13P-C | `35ba04efff34fe07d6aac37d1ddafad3587e51fea89bf54f9c144ca52fac713c` | 0/36 | 36/36 | 0/36 | 0/36 |
| BW13P-D | `3cdbf3db5bdfa028190a91f36c6d34e33a573e2a18eb3ef759ce164035b549ee` | 0/36 | 36/36 | 0/36 | 0/36 |

Exact paths, the separately retained interrupted attempt, source identity,
root cause, reservations, research inputs, and false claim fields are frozen
in
[`../sdk/balanced_wave_bw13p_r1_closure_manifest.json`](../sdk/balanced_wave_bw13p_r1_closure_manifest.json).
R1 cannot select a policy and may not be repaired or rerun.

The root cause was a shared production routing error. Because the old
fixed-exposure predicate keyed only on stability-policy identity, every
BW13P `post_settle_full` request inherited the fixed overlay route. Signed
phase offsets entered initial native memory before step zero, were also
scheduled at step `360`, and legacy base motor writes remained active. The
public `u64` gait-step boundary rejected the negative memory. The invariant
signature across every cell is `1,154` successful SDK steps, `2,880`
safe-disable motor writes, and
`STABILITY_OVERLAY_STEP_INVALID:ADAPTER_NATIVE_STEP_FAILED`.

The corrected successor infrastructure does not special-case the failure
inside a test. The physical loop consumes the public production resolver
`compile_sdk_execution_mode_plan()` from
[`../scripts/lab/gait/physical_wave_gait_quadruped.gd`](../scripts/lab/gait/physical_wave_gait_quadruped.gd).
That resolver makes full post-settle authority mutually exclusive with fixed
exposure, returns the exact initial gait memory, forbids legacy base writes,
and declares the single phase-offset application mode.

The adapter method
`preflight_perfect_declared_policy_runtime_horizon()` in
[`../scripts/lab/gait/sdk_godot_jolt_adapter.gd`](../scripts/lab/gait/sdk_godot_jolt_adapter.gd)
then advances real native controller memory and the real portable scheduler
over a complete no-world timeline. It validates every step, phase-mode
transition, plan receipt, eight-actuator command order, and next-memory value.

Receipt v5 in
[`../tests/test_sdk_full_integrity_gate_satisfiability.gd`](../tests/test_sdk_full_integrity_gate_satisfiability.gd)
is the one mandatory pre-world gate:

1. all four BW13P policy declarations at offsets `-3` and `-2` pass the exact
   production resolver and critical runtime boundary;
2. the worst signed route completes all `3,232` declared steps, all `3,232`
   native calls, all `3,232` portable plans, and all `25,856` ordered
   commands;
3. all eight declared v3 policies still pass their real policy semantics,
   endpoint mapping, bounded influence, typed-unavailable fail-zero path, and
   exact production aggregate analyzer on a perfect zero-defect result;
4. the combined full-authority path proves portable base plus stability
   contribution reaches exactly eight motor applications with nonzero
   effective influence and zero direct body writes; and
5. the retained R1 signed-initial-memory route fails at synthetic step zero,
   before a world can exist.

The perfect aggregate has zero errors, mismatches, failures, violations,
legacy writes, and safe-disable writes. Required nonzero policy activity is
still derived from real receipts; an “all-zero result” never fabricates an
inactive mechanism. This is launch satisfiability only, not evidence of
walking or balance.

The generic R05 launcher now validates receipt v5 before creating a durable
campaign directory, and QSDK-R05A inherits and reconciles the same fields.
Active conformance runs
[`../tests/test_bw13p_r1_closure.ps1`](../tests/test_bw13p_r1_closure.ps1)
instead of invoking R1 preflights. The next legal campaign must be a new,
prospectively frozen R2 source/preregistration identity. R05C indices
`193`-`204`, seeds `38101`-`38103`, and the unbiased friction reservation
remain unopened.

The method sources remain pinned at
[`../DReCon.pdf`](../DReCon.pdf),
[`../2604.08780v1.pdf`](../2604.08780v1.pdf),
[`../2507.22653v2.pdf`](../2507.22653v2.pdf), and
[`research/LOCOMOTION_RESEARCH_SOURCES.md`](research/LOCOMOTION_RESEARCH_SOURCES.md).

control on the exposed cohort. It did not show that the base controller uses
its commanded forward speed to place feet. BW14V tests that single missing
mechanism:

- A is exact `BW5R-B`;
- B inherits the exact A profile and adds a task-frame forward-velocity error
  correction to each hip's forward target;
- measured speed is the dot product of base linear velocity and the task
  forward axis;
- correction sign reverses when measured speed crosses desired speed;
- its magnitude is bounded by the existing `0.30`-rad forward hip target;
- a smoothstep scheduler envelope makes the correction continuous through
  swing, touchdown, stance, and the cycle boundary; and
- desired speed zero produces exactly zero correction.

The correction contains no morphology, material, seed, R05B-failure identity,
or outcome branch and introduces no fitted threshold. The portable Rust core
owns the computation and returns a typed four-limb receipt. Godot/Jolt may
only validate and apply that receipt through exclusive native motor
authority.

The paired comparison deliberately reuses the outcome-exposed R05B cohort
`181`-`192` with seeds `21601`-`21603`; it is hypothesis selection, not
independent validation. The frozen selector recomputes metrics from all 36 raw
results per arm and selects B only when it is strictly lexicographically
better than A. A tie rejects B. Even a B selection only authorizes a new,
prospectively frozen independent-validation campaign.

### Mandatory pre-world experiment satisfiability

Before any candidate creates a durable evidence directory or builds a world,
the launcher must prove both halves of the experiment result path:

1. the entire production integrity predicate accepts the exact declared policy
   on a synthetic perfect 36-cell matrix with every defect field equal to
   zero; and
2. deliberately nonzero failure, timeout, lateral, and cross-track sentinels
   survive the exact live ordered-object aggregator, JSON serialization,
   SHA-256, readback, and recomputation.

The first half catches a logically unrunnable experiment immediately: if a
perfect declared-policy result cannot pass the exact gate, no physical run is
permitted. The second catches false-green aggregation or serialization paths
that erase real failures. Together they cover the failure classes encountered
in BW9L, BW10F, and BW13P-R2 without weakening any scientific threshold.

The implementation surfaces are:

At this freeze point, Rust workspace tests, the zero-world Godot authority

## BW15F global sign/gain successor boundary

BW14V's complete paired result falsified the full-scale treatment on this
cohort, but it did not uniquely identify whether the failure came from error
orientation, gain, or phase. The retained matched post-hoc diagnostic is
[`../sdk/balanced_wave_bw14v_posthoc_diagnostic.json`](../sdk/balanced_wave_bw14v_posthoc_diagnostic.json),
audited by
[`../tests/test_bw14v_posthoc_diagnostic.ps1`](../tests/test_bw14v_posthoc_diagnostic.ps1).
Across all 36 pairs, treatment B reached the declared `0.30`-rad correction
cap, had less evidence-window forward displacement, greater maximum tilt, and
lower minimum torso height than control. It also produced a release timeout
in 31 cells. Those are diagnostic facts about the exposed cohort, not a
walking or causal-mechanism promotion.

`BW15F-MORPHOLOGY-DEVELOPMENT` therefore freezes a small, global four-arm
factorial in
[`../sdk/balanced_wave_bw15f_morphology_development_preregistration.json`](../sdk/balanced_wave_bw15f_morphology_development_preregistration.json),
raw SHA-256
`722a65c741d3bd41c5374225c5d7b0d611ce87cf5ac5ede1d3eda9142c362e29`:

- A is the exact `BW5R-B` control;
- B uses `desired - measured` orientation at a `0.03`-rad global cap;
- C changes only the orientation to `measured - desired` at the same
  `0.03`-rad cap; and
- D changes only C's global cap from `0.03` to `0.06` rad.

Thus B/C isolate orientation and C/D isolate gain. Every treatment inherits
all non-mechanism profile fields from A, keeps the BW14V continuous
swing/stance envelope, and contains zero morphology, material, seed, known
failure, or outcome branches. If none of B/C/D strictly beats A, a phase
experiment requires a new identity; BW15F cannot be patched after outcome
inspection.

The portable Rust core owns the signed error and bounded correction. Its
receipt v5 names the error orientation, declared gain, normalized signed
error, and four ordered limb corrections. The Godot/Jolt adapter validates
the receipt and applies it through exclusive native motor authority. The
zero-world contract
[`../tests/test_sdk_balanced_wave_bw15f_authority_contract.gd`](../tests/test_sdk_balanced_wave_bw15f_authority_contract.gd)
passes `8/8`, including exact B/C sign inversion, exact C/D gain ratio,
hash-bound profiles, policy routing, and zero world construction.

The physical harness and runner are
[`../tests/test_sdk_balanced_wave_bw15f_morphology_development.gd`](../tests/test_sdk_balanced_wave_bw15f_morphology_development.gd)
and
[`../sdk/run_balanced_wave_bw15f_morphology_development.ps1`](../sdk/run_balanced_wave_bw15f_morphology_development.ps1).
Before durable output or any world, each arm must pass the complete declared
policy gate on a perfect synthetic matrix, the nonzero ordered-dictionary
canary, all 36 real entrypoints, the zero-world mechanism contract, and the
four-report selector regression. All four `36`-world reports are mandatory;
there is no early stopping.

The selector

### BW19V post-closure inferential boundary

The strict finite-cohort selector was load-bearing: tie or worse would have
rejected the scale-`0.5` hypothesis and selected nothing. Its exact descriptive
predicate passed and remains immutable. The paired outcomes were `30`
both-pass, `2` both-fail, `3` treatment-only pass, and `1` control-only pass.
The post-hoc exact paired probabilities are `0.3125` one-sided and `0.625`
two-sided under equal discordant direction, so BW19V does not establish
population superiority, non-inferiority, or a general effect-size lower bound.
The executable reconstruction is
[`../tests/test_bw19v_inferential_boundary.ps1`](../tests/test_bw19v_inferential_boundary.ps1).

Scale `0.5` remains eligible as a successor-testing candidate under the
already-frozen finite result; it is not promoted to the quadruped release
policy. Future load-bearing comparisons must declare whether they are exact
finite decisions, development screening, superiority, or

## Rapier ForceBased host-correction closure

The next Rapier identity is
`C6-RAPIER-FORCE-BASED-HOST-CHARACTERIZATION`, gate
`C6-RAP-HC-FB1`. It does not modify or rerun the closed host R2 or locomotion
R2 identities. Its declaration is
[`../sdk/rapier_c6_force_based_host_characterization_preregistration.json`](../sdk/rapier_c6_force_based_host_characterization_preregistration.json),
SHA-256
`7d3753308707f4e96b33959eea5dbf0ad54ae6e442614a2acb87d339c26d20dc`.

The implementation explicitly calls and reads back
`MotorModel::ForceBased` on builder and mutable update paths. The frozen
eight-world grid contains four unloaded position/impulse cells, two
opposite-signed velocity cells, and two opposite-offset gravity-loaded
support cells. The paired loaded cells must produce opposite angle and motor
impulse signs while remaining within the frozen angle and impulse bounds.

[`../sdk/run_rapier_c6_force_based_host_characterization.ps1`](../sdk/run_rapier_c6_force_based_host_characterization.ps1)
runs the entire synthetic integrity gate first. Its current zero-world result
passes: the default-model canary reads `AccelerationBased`, both explicit
paths read `ForceBased`, a perfect declared result passes, and a one-count
model mismatch fails closed.

The one permitted physical report ran from clean, pushed source
`331ebe36e609fa387869fefcb70e62f63e9817a9` and is retained at
`<evidence-root>\c6-rapier-force-based-host-characterization-331ebe3\report.json`,
raw SHA-256
`5b053de8f9128920ba4b64407a4c3867171579a1aca74aff4e50dfaffa308bd3`.
It closed negative at `6/8`: all eight model readbacks were `ForceBased`,
with zero mismatches, nonfinite observations, or impulse-limit violations;
the four unloaded position cells and two signed-velocity cells passed.

The two gravity-loaded cells alone failed the frozen absolute terminal motor
impulse minimum. They held at approximately `+/-0.07364 rad`, showed zero
anchor error and the required opposite paired signs, but produced only
approximately `+/-0.001221695 N m s` of terminal motor impulse versus the
preregistered `0.005 N m s` minimum. That observed threshold failure remains
a failure. The immutable disposition is
[`../sdk/rapier_c6_force_based_host_characterization_closure.json`](../sdk/rapier_c6_force_based_host_characterization_closure.json),
raw SHA-256
`48a46e3533a45226f8dddab64d962814bd88e3526202d48242b0400ec9d32416`,
with its executable audit in
[`../tests/test_rapier_c6_force_based_host_characterization_closure.ps1`](../tests/test_rapier_c6_force_based_host_characterization_closure.ps1).

Rapier `0.34.0` divides the outer step by `num_solver_iterations` before
solving joint constraints and writes the current small-step motor impulse back
to `JointMotor.impulse`. The observed magnitude times `20`,
`0.001221695 * 20 = 0.0244339 N m s`, closely matches the static full-step
load estimate `1 * 9.8 * 0.3 / 120 = 0.0245 N m s`. That source-grounded
relationship is a successor hypothesis, not a repair or pass for FB1.
Future numeric physical gates must retain explicit provenance from pinned host
semantics, dimensional derivation, or separate development calibration.

FB1 therefore authorizes no Rapier host or locomotion claim.

#### Completed ASD1 zero-world actuation-semantics diagnosis

ED1's source-grounded question is now answered by retained diagnostic
[`../sdk/rapier_c6_bw19v_actuation_semantics_diagnostic.json`](../sdk/rapier_c6_bw19v_actuation_semantics_diagnostic.json),

`a42888f04c9a42af78ab3796dee9cc98365592470f81d0153bc55ab2a375ca57`.
It reconstructs pushed source `22ca385` plus the already-retained ED1 trace
with zero world builds, scene insertions, physics mutations, or new physical
observations.

The portable selected controller computes the complete position-error and
measured-rate velocity feedback, then embeds the Godot/Jolt host sign `-1` in
its emitted value. Godot/Jolt applies only that velocity target, so this
preserves its captured working command. Rapier uses canonical-to-host sign
`+1` but does not convert the base value, adds a correctly signed canonical
residual to it, and supplies both base position and composed velocity to a
ForceBased `40/10` motor. The selected Rapier path therefore mixed coordinate
spaces and duplicated position feedback; it was not semantically equivalent
to Godot/Jolt.

The source-derived `+0.3 rad` zero-state example produces canonical
`+2.4 rad/s`, emitted Godot host `-2.4 rad/s`, and Rapier nominal combined
force `-12 N m`, opposing the position error. ED1 step `0` confirms physical
activation without assigning whole-body causation: all `5/5` nonzero position
targets oppose their velocity targets, and all `5/5` next joint angles move
with velocity rather than position sign. The representative front-right hip
is `+0.32291965834746944 rad`, `-2.5806550975692217 rad/s`, and
`-0.004242065828293562 rad` after the step.

The exact classification is a confirmed cross-host actuation-semantics defect
with unresolved whole-body causal effect. It does not establish that the
defect alone caused ED1 torso contact, that corrected Rapier will walk, that
BW19V's residual should be deleted, or that the working Godot/Jolt
architecture failed. ED1 remains closed under its original residual
intervention and result.

VH1 uses ForceBased velocity-only actuation: host sign `+1`, target position
zero as non-load-bearing provenance, stiffness exactly zero, damping `10`, and
maximum torque `6`. Its source-derived loaded prediction is
`velocity = target + external_torque / damping`; the expected steady motor
impulse magnitude is `|external_torque| * (1/120) / 16`.

The complete ordered grid is twelve fresh cells:

- four unloaded target velocities: `±0.75` and `±2.25 rad/s`; and
- the cross of target velocities `±1.5 rad/s` with constant torques
  `±0.75` and `±2.25 N m`, producing eight loaded cells.

All cells run `360` outer steps. Acceptance begins no earlier than step `120`
and requires `60` consecutive acceptable steps. Velocity and loaded-impulse
responses use the frozen `[0.98, 1.02]` band, signed-pair asymmetry is at most
`0.005`, anchor error is at most `1e-5 m`, every builder and per-step mutable
field must read back exactly, and the per-small-step force cap must never be
violated. The grid has no selector, replacement, early stop, or population
claim.

The zero-world implementation and guarded runner are
[`../sdk/adapters/rapier/src/force_based_velocity_only_characterization.rs`](../sdk/adapters/rapier/src/force_based_velocity_only_characterization.rs)
and
[`../sdk/run_rapier_c6_force_based_velocity_only_host_characterization_vh1.ps1`](../sdk/run_rapier_c6_force_based_velocity_only_host_characterization_vh1.ps1).
The runner now binds the evaluator raw SHA-256
`2ba5cde0f3615a401b4bc890d9ba8a8db393bad74bf351574923fc4f878e8359`
and CLI raw SHA-256
`ac9bc8fb81349a58f35ae0561a53fd44944ceb3b041e71fa80024bbea27e4442`
in addition to its declared semantic, configuration, lock, predecessor, and
upstream-source inventory. Those repository-owned identities have explicit
LF checkout rules.
The perfect synthetic `12/12` result passes the complete cell/pair/aggregate
evaluator, builder and mutable paths both read back ForceBased with stiffness
zero, serialization round-trips, and nine missing/model/stiffness/target/
response/sign/impulse/authority canaries fail closed. Actual world count is
zero and every physical claim remains false.

The physical runner could not be entered implicitly: it required

## BW18G frozen branch-free residual-scale successor

BW18G is the next prospective quadruped development family. It does not
repair, rerun, or reinterpret BW17P. BW17P's full portable-plan treatment
walked in `27/36`, versus `29/36` for its control, while improving some
secondary false-gate and timeout diagnostics. BW18G asks one narrower
question: can a single global residual scale retain those secondary benefits
without the primary walking-count regression?

All four arms keep exactly the same BW15F-B controller, BW13P-A portable
scheduled-support plan, Godot/Jolt material, exclusive `post_settle_full`
native authority, morphology/seed pairing, and final adapter composition.
Only one portable-core scalar differs:

| Candidate | Global requested-correction scale | Role |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `BW18G-A` | `0.00` | exact-zero residual control |
| `BW18G-B` | `0.25` | low-scale treatment |
| `BW18G-C` | `0.50` | mid-scale treatment |
| `BW18G-D` | `1.00` | full-scale treatment |

There are no morphology, material, seed, failure-identity, or outcome
conditions and no branch surfaces. The scale is applied by the portable core
before the existing magnitude and slew limits. The new public operation is
`ss_bound_stability_influence_v3_json`; the Rust, C header, Python binding,
and Godot GDExtension surfaces all expose the same typed request/receipt. The
receipt retains raw, scaled, and applied values, so candidate A must prove a
nonzero raw witness followed by exact-zero scaled and applied residuals.
Candidates B-D must prove nonzero effective application.

The prospective declarations are:

- [`../sdk/balanced_wave_bw18g_residual_scale_candidates.json`](../sdk/balanced_wave_bw18g_residual_scale_candidates.json),
  raw SHA-256
  `a6bc578006217c8bea3601c1de2b62bbcaaa6fbb5809679d8bd97a2fac9e3d7f`;
- [`../sdk/balanced_wave_bw18g_morphology_development_preregistration.json`](../sdk/balanced_wave_bw18g_morphology_development_preregistration.json),
  raw SHA-256
  `86ee6166408e3a60b649f6c618d559dd5accd8b8e7dc5b5af68e2a07b519edfa`;

- [`../sdk/compile_balanced_wave_bw18g_selection.ps1`](../sdk/compile_balanced_wave_bw18g_selection.ps1);
- [`../tests/test_sdk_balanced_wave_bw18g_scale_contract.gd`](../tests/test_sdk_balanced_wave_bw18g_scale_contract.gd);

- [`../tests/test_bw18g_selector.ps1`](../tests/test_bw18g_selector.ps1).

Before the freeze was committed, the zero-world boundary passed:

No BW18G physics world had opened at this freeze. After this source is clean,
committed, pushed, and `HEAD == origin/main`, run each arm once into a
non-temporary evidence root:

```powershell
$evidence = (
  "<evidence-root>\" +

)
foreach ($candidate in "BW18G-A", "BW18G-B", "BW18G-C", "BW18G-D") {
```

## C6-HC1 prospective host-characterization freeze

Cross-engine infrastructure now advances without promoting any rejected
controller or balance composition. The prospective declaration is
[`../sdk/cross_engine_c6_host_characterization_preregistration.json`](../sdk/cross_engine_c6_host_characterization_preregistration.json),
raw SHA-256
`2ff51bc87745d84f2d4d0521005098ead3bef20e691b25f9f49c0cf7eadade8e`,
with implementation parent
`2a78dea1148d817e2018830f3bba1e1e776ecd64`.

C6-HC1 measures the exact Rapier 0.34.0 and MuJoCo 3.11.0 material and
actuator boundaries required by ADR-017 before a future same-policy physical
C6. It crosses three discrete authored sliding-friction values with seven
force ratios, observes free sliding, and crosses two signed revolute targets
with two per-step impulse limits. Each host therefore owns `28` worlds.

The implementation paths are:

- [`../sdk/adapters/rapier/src/characterization.rs`](../sdk/adapters/rapier/src/characterization.rs);
- [`../sdk/adapters/rapier/src/bin/characterization.rs`](../sdk/adapters/rapier/src/bin/characterization.rs);
- [`../sdk/adapters/mujoco/sporespore_mujoco_adapter/characterization.py`](../sdk/adapters/mujoco/sporespore_mujoco_adapter/characterization.py);
  and
- [`../sdk/run_cross_engine_c6_host_characterization.ps1`](../sdk/run_cross_engine_c6_host_characterization.ps1).

The launcher always runs both complete result-integrity gates on perfect
synthetic all-zero inputs before a world. It also injects a nonzero
breakaway-failure canary that both gates reject. The current prospective
source reports zero world builds, zero scene insertions, and zero physics
mutations in both preflights.

No physical grid may start until this freeze is committed and pushed and
`HEAD == origin/main` with a clean worktree. The first complete report for
each host/source is immutable and must live beneath the durable
`SporeSpore_Evidence` root. Every declared cell is attempted even after a
failure, the negative report is retained before the host exits unsuccessfully,
and the supervisor continues the other host. A failed or partial result is
not silently repaired under the same identity.

C6-HC1 is not locomotion and is not the unbiased friction reservation. It
cannot repair or promote BW16S or BW17P, satisfy R05C, or establish arbitrary
quadrupeds, continuous morphology, terrain, pushes, sensor faults, selected
policy authority, different-engine locomotion, cross-engine C6, release, or a
completed SDK.

local method inputs remain byte-pinned:

BW16S proved that the P5I.3C physical overlay was real and materially changed
secondary diagnostics, but it lost the frozen primary walking comparison.
BW17P does not repair or reinterpret BW16S. It asks a new, narrower
development question: whether the already-implemented portable-core BW13P-A
shared-baseline scheduled-support plan improves the unchanged BW15F-B
controller relative to the exact no-overlay control.

The prospective contract is frozen in
[`../sdk/balanced_wave_bw17p_morphology_development_preregistration.json`](../sdk/balanced_wave_bw17p_morphology_development_preregistration.json).

[`../sdk/balanced_wave_bw17p_portable_plan_candidates.json`](../sdk/balanced_wave_bw17p_portable_plan_candidates.json):

| `BW17P-B` | `sporespore_scheduled_load_transfer_bw13p_a_v3` | unchanged BW15F-B under exclusive `post_settle_full` native authority plus the portable-core planned, mapped, bounded stability contribution | `sha256:b25729d73a07007c5cb49d0fe522c3e9e574413ebb19167339091106ca5da212` |

BW13P-A is reused because its complete R3 control arm recorded `35/36`

is frozen before execution, and the portable plan retains `mode=control`:
the optional preferred-normal-force and remaining-support-centroid factors
are both inactive. The shared baseline centroidal command, mass conservation,
typed scheduler boundary, endpoint-force mapping, characterized actuator
conversion, bounded contribution, and final eight-motor write remain
receipted. No new gain or morphology, material, seed, failure-identity, or

Both arms reuse R05C indices `193`-`204`, seeds `38101`-`38103`, material,

## BW17P complete negative development closure

Both BW17P arms completed from clean pushed source
`271cdff4f8fc8896793914ebb911192bd6a5ca96`. The family retains `72/72`
complete harness, integrity, controller-mechanism, and combined-application
receipts. No physical world was rerun, replaced, deleted, averaged, or
reclassified.

The exact evidence lives beneath
`<evidence-root>\bw17p-morphology-development-271cdff`.
Its top-level immutable artifacts are:

- A report SHA-256:
  `651499955e2ef847a5ecc4214f4429c66a253c467dc693e40f59360819583bb8`;
- B report SHA-256:
  `0f9f823a20fa31f00c5da0cd80d35bd2ad7b1c55665edf3c12fbe145f83aaa96`;
  and
- selection SHA-256:
  `3e91cbb39f91c1c99a1b411c8408bb87e44a47f4858039945edf66f9132c4d06`.

The no-plan A control walks in `29/36`, with metric vector
`[7, 25, 15, 5.488835366380132, 19.693325581880757,
45.15938733062067]`. The portable-plan B treatment walks in `27/36`, with
vector `[9, 22, 10, 5.498809578414164, 23.3242769801552,
46.54274443313446]`. Walking failures are the first frozen selection metric.
B's nine failures are worse than A's seven, so the selector records
`family_selected=false`,
`result_status=bw17p_family_rejected_treatment_worse_than_control`, and no
selected composition.

The negative result is not an adapter or missing-mechanism result. B produced
`100,589` exact portable-plan receipts and typed contribution attempts,
`804,712` influence outputs and final native motor writes, `90,663` nonzero
contribution attempts, and `641,172` nonzero effective applications. The
plan's control mode kept active, preferred-normal, and remaining-centroid
factor counts at exactly zero. The available/unavailable/infeasible
partition was `90,663 / 3,030 / 6,896`, and every unavailable or infeasible
step failed to typed zero.

B reduced raw false walking receipts from `25` to `22` and release timeouts
from `15` to `10`, but maximum lateral displacement, aggregate lateral
displacement, aggregate cross-track error, and the primary walking metric
worsened. Those mixed secondary diagnostics cannot override the primary
rejection or authorize a new selector.

[`../sdk/balanced_wave_bw17p_closure_manifest.json`](../sdk/balanced_wave_bw17p_closure_manifest.json)
pins the complete disposition. Its independent audit,
[`../tests/test_bw17p_closure.ps1`](../tests/test_bw17p_closure.ps1),
reconstructs both reports from raw results and hash-verifies `76` declared
source references, `224` retained cell/preflight artifacts, `2` reports, and
the selection.

BW17P is closed. It may not be repaired, rerun, reclassified, relaxed,
averaged, or selectively subset. The BW13P-A plan composition does not
advance, and the portable release policy is unchanged. A new controller or
composition needs a distinct prospective source and preregistration
identity; a later acceptance campaign still needs unopened morphologies and
fresh seeds.

Cross-engine C6 may continue as engine infrastructure without promoting this
rejected composition. BW17P grants no walking acceptance, balance
improvement, independent morphology validation, arbitrary-quadruped or
continuous-volume claim, friction/material robustness, terrain, pushes,
sensor faults, engine equivalence, variable limb counts, running, bipeds,
release, or completed engine-neutral SDK authority. The unbiased friction
reservation remains unopened.

that identity scientifically invalid. Its seven failed cells and 25 false
walking booleans remain diagnostic only. BW16S therefore introduces no
failure-conditioned rule. It tests one previously implemented portable
mechanism on the entire paired, now-outcome-exposed cohort under a distinct
development identity.

The P5I.3C law is not new and was not fit to R05C. It retains horizontal
position/velocity gains `5.0 N/m` and `0.1 Ns/m`, maximum horizontal force
`0.75 N`, roll/pitch position/velocity gains `0.5 Nm/rad` and
`0.05 Nms/rad`, maximum roll/pitch moment `0.1 Nm`, and exact-zero vertical
feedback.

The route difference is part of the declared factor and the evidence, not
hidden noise. Candidate A has zero legacy post-settle/evidence writes.
Candidate B uses the previously commissioned overlay semantics: a transient
host base write is retained and counted, followed by the adapter's final
portable base-plus-contribution motor write. Treatment eligibility requires:

1. one exact BW15F-B controller-mechanism receipt per SDK step;
2. one typed P5I.3C contribution attempt and eight typed influence outputs per
   SDK step;
3. one overlay application and eight final overlay motor writes per SDK step;
4. at least one nonzero effective stability application in every cell;
5. exact final-write/readback and speed-limit compliance; and
6. zero mapping, limiter, inactive-zero, profile-conversion, overlay, direct
   body-write, mismatch, safe-disable, or safe-no-actuation failures.

The generator indices `193`-`204`, seeds `38101`-`38103`, material
`godot_jolt_bw5c_mu095_v1`, solver, host scaffold, and walking thresholds are
identical across both arms. Because R05C opened them, they are explicitly

replacement, early stop, or threshold change is allowed.

Before a physical world, each arm has passed:

- the full immutable R05C closure audit;
- the perfect declared-policy gate at all eight boundaries and worst signed
  runtime horizon;
- the `10/10` zero-world BW16S authority contract;
- all `36/36` real candidate entrypoints (`72/72` across the pair);
- strict-selector treatment-win, tie-rejection, loss-rejection,

- the perfect all-zero 36-cell production aggregate;
- the deliberately nonzero three-failed-gate/two-timeout canary; and
- a complete serialize/read/recompute report round trip with 30 retained
  source hashes.

The new cell envelope exports every raw false walking boolean count and the
exact summed release-timeout count. This prevents the limitation discovered
in R05C from recurring while preserving R05C's immutable historical bytes.

After the freeze is committed and pushed, run the same cold gate from
PowerShell:

```powershell
foreach ($candidate in "BW16S-A", "BW16S-B") {
  .\sdk\run_balanced_wave_bw16s_morphology_development.ps1 `
    -Candidate $candidate `
    -PreflightOnly
}
```

Only then may the first complete reports be written beneath the durable
`<evidence-root>` root. Both 36-world
reports are mandatory and final for their source identity. The selector first
requires `36/36` integrity, mechanism, and combined application in both
reports. It then compares, in order:

1. walking-conjunction failures;
2. exact raw false production-walking booleans;
3. exact release timeouts;
4. maximum normalized absolute lateral displacement;
5. aggregate normalized absolute lateral displacement; and
6. aggregate cumulative absolute cross-track error.

B is selected only if it is strictly lexicographically better than A. A tie
or control win rejects B. Selection remains a development result and requires
an unopened population plus fresh seeds before any promotion.

BW16S grants no walking acceptance, balance improvement, independent
morphology validation, arbitrary-quadruped or continuous-volume claim,
friction/material robustness, terrain, pushes, sensor faults, different
engines, variable limb counts, running, bipeds, release, or completed
engine-neutral SDK authority.

## Active Rapier v4 BW19V velocity-only composition

The next cross-engine layer is now implemented and completely zero-world
gated. Its declaration is
[`../sdk/rapier_c6_velocity_only_live_integration_v1.json`](../sdk/rapier_c6_velocity_only_live_integration_v1.json),
raw SHA-256
`7c4c7435ca02f30073d5a33fce162fef67a461340ae609225b096abe59f88507`.
The active v2 configuration is
[`../sdk/rapier_c6_velocity_only_active_configuration_v2.json`](../sdk/rapier_c6_velocity_only_active_configuration_v2.json),
raw SHA-256
`fb16ede4b295f69a343dde239c98874d547aba6cec6d47a71df1797f6c03c8fe`.
The predecessor v1 active configuration remains immutable at raw SHA-256
`dc1eb57df75a41cb5ab80c45e537e7bd0974df0ac9cc7d738e24f08daaf60737`
for closed-campaign reconstruction.

The working BW19V architecture was preserved. The BW15F-B portable base and
the scale-`0.5` scheduled-support contribution remain separate until both are
in their declared canonical velocity frame. The correct operation is not to
delete the base controller or blindly reverse the final result. It is:

```text
portable canonical base = legacy Godot host base * -1
complete canonical command = portable canonical base + BW19V canonical residual
Rapier host command = complete canonical command * +1
```

Clamping occurs on the complete canonical command. Rapier then applies only a
`ForceBased` velocity motor: target position absent, native stiffness `0`,
damping `10 N m s/rad`, explicit builder and mutable model selection, and full
field readback. The historical pre-v4 projection added a canonical residual
directly to a legacy Godot-host base. It is retained only as a negative
witness. The selected eight-actuator BW15F-B synthetic frame contains five
nonzero commands for which the old and v4 projections differ, so the semantic
defect is now demonstrated rather than assumed.

The portable maximum impulse budget is also mapped without the old `1.015`
margin. V4 uses `maximum_force = maximum_outer_step_impulse / outer_dt`, then
checks Rapier's observable small-step motor impulse against
`maximum_force * outer_dt / 16`. For s169, the derived force range is about
`5.2651`-`6.7648 N m`, and the small-step impulse-cap range is about
`0.0027423`-`0.0035234 N m s`. VH1 physically characterized an exact finite
host grid with a `6 N m` force cap; it did not physically validate this whole
per-actuator range or the selected morphology.

The executable gate is
[`../sdk/run_rapier_c6_velocity_only_live_integration_preflight.ps1`](../sdk/run_rapier_c6_velocity_only_live_integration_preflight.ps1).
Its current receipt is:

```text
C6_RAP_V4_LIVE_INTEGRATION_PREFLIGHT_PASS policy=BW15F-B scale=0.5 actuators=8 mixed_space_witnesses=5 worlds=0 physical_authority=False
```

It binds the positive immutable VH1 closure at
`d94b20ef4767479172408c1dfbd0b7f66e18e3f4bc8b9d8d84193fc157d284aa`
and proves all eight ordered commands, exact canonical mapping, zero native
position targets, exact ForceBased builder/mutable readbacks, force-cap
reconstruction, serialization, and zero-world authority. It rejects missing
or reordered residuals, wrong sign, default `AccelerationBased`, nonzero
stiffness, wrong target, wrong force, and authority inflation. The source and
claim audit is
[`../tests/test_rapier_c6_velocity_only_active_configuration_v2.ps1`](../tests/test_rapier_c6_velocity_only_active_configuration_v2.ps1),
and the gate runs near the start of
[`../sdk/run_conformance.ps1`](../sdk/run_conformance.ps1), before physical
conformance fixtures.

The first draft of this gate failed with
`C6_RAP_V4_SELECTED_POLICY_IDENTITY_MISMATCH`: a retained commissioning helper
selected an older policy identity. This was not accepted as harmless and was
not tuned around. The live-v4 boundary now constructs
`sporespore_balanced_wave_bw15f_b_v1` explicitly. No physics world opened, and
the failure is retained here as a concrete negative integration example.

The bounded advance is semantic and implementational. The v4 constructor,
composition, apply, settle, and small-step impulse enforcement now exist as a
separate path, and the Rapier capability manifest is v2. The historical VH1
closure still correctly says it did not perform live integration; this later
declaration is the integration authority. No v4 selected-policy world has
run, so Rapier walking, locomotion acceptance, cross-engine equivalence,
friction robustness, arbitrary quadrupeds, release, and completed-SDK status
remain false.

The next physical step must be a new, prospectively frozen early-horizon
development screen—not an FB1, VH1, C1, C2, or ED1 rerun. It must call only
`build_bw19v_velocity_only_v4_robot`, `compose_bw19v_step_v4`,

`hold_velocity_only_v4_zero_and_step`; retain exact BW19V scale `0.5` and the
portable support contribution; record the motor/readback/impulse and early
failure observables; and prove its complete synthetic integrity gate from
clean pushed source before the first world.

The complete non-Godot pipeline then passed twice; the final strengthened

portable-core tests, 27 Rapier tests, 2 Godot adapter Rust tests, every
retained closure and selector, ABI/versioning and adapter-authoring checks,
